abstract: We studied the chemo-radiotherapy of testicular tumors in clinical stage III. Our study involved 54 patients with lung metastases of seminoma and nonseminoma, treated with a combination of radiotherapy and chemotherapy. The results obtained have not satisfied our expectations. While in the 16 seminoma patients only 43% overall response rate was obtained (probably due to the bad general condition of the patients who had mostly received previous treatment), in the 38 nonseminoma patients a 63% overall response rate was obtained, with 31% complete remission. In previously untreated patients a 73% overall response rate was obtained at 34% complete remission.
abstract_ja: 我々は、臨床病期IIIの精巣腫瘍患者の化学放射線療法を検討した。対象はセミノーマと非セミノーマの肺転移を有する54例である。セミノーマの16例では全奏効率43%にとどまったが（患者の全身状態が不良で、ほとんどが前治療を受けていたことが原因と考えられる）、非セミノーマの38例では全奏効率63%、完全寛解31%が得られた。未治療の患者では、全奏効率73%、完全寛解34%が得られた。結果は期待どおりではなかった。
